image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a textured, greyish-brown surface resembling wet stone or concrete. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular yellow blotches and spots. Its skin appears wet and reflective. The head is broad, and the limbs are visible, splayed out to support the body. There is some text-like artifacting in the bottom right corner.
